purpose: read-only physical CVAFRS06 field audit and modeled candidate sizes; no acceptance claim

container_framing.header: CVA magic, v2.0, little-endian header length (16 or 40 bytes)
container_framing.chunk: u64 little-endian payload length followed by exact payload bytes
container_framing.publication: CVAPUB01 envelope, body offset 17 for clock tag 0/2 or 25 for tag 1

codec_basis.record_wire_bytes: i16 score; optional admitted and accounted turns (each tag+u64); exact observed bytes are retained per record, including tag-dependent lengths
codec_basis.candidate_size_status: modeled exact byte counts for the described schemas; no new codec implemented

candidate_comparison.lossless_dictionary: Full semantic authority retained. Sorted unique MemoryId and UTF-8 text dictionaries replace repeated inline values with ULEB128 indexes; all event digests/turns/effects, cohorts and complete records remain. No semantic reconstruction dependency.
candidate_comparison.lossless_prefix_delta_deduplicated: Full semantic authority retained. Adds UTF-8 byte prefix-compressed strings, sorted MemoryId dictionary, a deduplicated shared table of sorted per-field ID sets encoded as delta ULEB indexes, and a deduplicated table of exact variable-length record-value bytes. Event recipient sets are re-used when equal to another field/event set.
candidate_comparison.event_id_spine_reconstruction: Aggressive optimistic bound: retains selected event IDs plus a superseded tag and one ordered leaf commitment, but drops FreshnessRecord postimages and requires excluded-settlement replay to reconstruct them. This has a circularity/replay risk and is not the smallest justified no-semantic-loss candidate.
candidate_comparison.event_id_spine_retained_postimages: Conditional framed-scope candidate only: preserves all exact FreshnessRecord postimages, affected/cohort sets, accepted event IDs, superseded tags, and a commitment; derives source_nodes and born IDs from retained framed proofs and resolves event details by exact IDs. It avoids circular postimage replay. Not justified for all current supported scopes because an initial/unframed legacy predecessor has no ImportStart/receipt from which exact source_nodes can be derived, yet Freshness validation and scope consumers still use them.

smallest_currently_justified_without_sem.reason: The current implementation explicitly supports initial/unframed settlements. Their source_nodes cannot be assumed derivable from an Archive ImportReceipt; preserving all authority fields is the only measured candidate here that is safe across framed and initial scopes without a separately proven initial-source derivation or contract change.

two_stage_hydration_feasibility.framed_scopes: Architecturally feasible without codec callbacks or Archive/Insomnia logic in Freshness: Freshness decodes a compact envelope retaining postimages, cuts, sets, event IDs and root; Freshness resolves exact event IDs/leaves using its own journal. After owner stores are finished, History derives source_nodes from ImportStart+Archive ImportReceipt and born IDs from Insomnia completion/Episode/Memory first-mutation proofs, then validates/hydrates before exposing the final settlement projection.
two_stage_hydration_feasibility.initial_unframed_scopes: Not proven feasible for the 207,071-byte candidate. `history/epoch_scope_proof.rs` explicitly takes an InitialHistory branch when no epoch exists, requiring base_cut=0 and born_memories=cohort but with no receipt to reconstruct source_nodes. `freshness_import_events.rs::validate_semantic_import_evidence` uses source_nodes to authorize superseded source events, and `scope_identity()` exposes the exact set to callers. Retain source_nodes for this branch or establish a new exact derivation and update/prove all consumers before counting these savings.
two_stage_hydration_feasibility.minimal_seam: Use a distinct decoded compact-envelope type in Freshness; locally validate exact event IDs/root and apply retained record postimages; defer the source/birth-dependent supersession check. Add a History-owned finalizer after Archive/Memory/epoch reconstruction and before final validation/public exposure. History must hydrate a complete semantic settlement, with the initial branch retaining source_nodes (or a separately proven equivalent). Completion hashing remains over exact physical compact bytes.
current_blockers: FreshnessStore::ingest_import_settlement currently decodes full semantic authority and calls validate_semantic_import_evidence immediately.
History::validate_settlement_scope requires semantic Some, then validates framed receipt/birth proofs or the explicit InitialHistory path.
Import readiness and reconciliation consume scope_identity source_nodes/born_memories; they cannot receive an unresolved projection.
Completion proof decodes the settlement before final History hydration and binds the raw payload digest; the compact envelope must expose owner/import/start/cut identity during that scan.

retained_evidence_and_transforms.prune_reclaim: Current REL prune/reclaim validation compares transformed-copy semantic settlements, ImportEpoch status, Freshness policy/current projection, owner evidence digest, and clocks. A compact format can survive only if Archive ImportReceipt plus required Episode/Node/Insomnia/Memory birth proofs and referenced CVAFRS02 event frames remain available; current transformed-copy proof is the validation seam.
retained_evidence_and_transforms.rewrite: Current rewrite emits a new owner generation and does not copy ImportEpochStore/settlement frames; it is a generation boundary rather than preservation of CVAFRS06. Any requirement to inspect old settlement authority across rewrite needs explicit lineage/format scope.
retained_evidence_and_transforms.same_turn_attribution: Cuts cannot by themselves distinguish exact events at the same activity turn. Preserve accepted event IDs explicitly and resolve each ID uniquely against retained CVAFRS02; recompute canonical digest/turn/recipient leaves and verify the aggregate commitment.

limitations: Dictionary candidate size assumes a new canonical schema with deterministic lexicographic dictionaries and ULEB128 indexes; bytes are exact for that stated layout, not measured runtime output.

Reconstruction candidate savings are conditional. The postimage-retaining candidate avoids base-state replay but still requires retained owner proofs, exact event lookup, transform retention and completion-digest migration to be proven at S3/C3.
The report keeps baseline source hashes and file sizes; a checksum validates each settlement payload. No corpus bytes are written.
